name: fmp_earnings_transcript
description:
Earnings call transcript for one company and fiscal quarter from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP): the full text of the call.
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/earnings-call-transcript as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, sent as given, e.g. AAPL), quarter (integer 1-4), year (integer, e.g. 2025); quarter and year are sent only when given (no default: FMP then chooses the transcript).
For call dates and EPS surprises use fmp_earnings_calendar.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "quarter": 2, "year": 2025}

year.description: Fiscal year, e.g. 2025 (sent only when given)
